info.title: ZidTrack API
info.description: ZidTrack REST API for authentication, leads, teams' sales activity, notifications, and mobile chat.

post.description: The `channel_name` must be `private-chat.user.{user_id}` for the authenticated user.
A direct conversation requires one other member. Group creation requires permission and a group name.
